source.generator: NVIDIA Kimodo (text to motion), SOMA 77-joint skeleton
source.upstream_note: Clips made with NVIDIA Kimodo (NVIDIA Open Model License). NVIDIA claims no ownership of outputs.

fields.seconds / frames / fps: of the .vrma file: frames is the number of keys, seconds the last key's time
fields.loop: true when the file repeats seamlessly: its last key is its first pose
fields.in_place: true when horizontal hips travel was removed, so code moves the character
fields.speed: upstream's default playback rate for the move; not baked into the keys unless passes.speed_baked
fields.passes: what the converter did to the stored clip; passes.loop.source_start/end are frames of the .npz, and the last passes.loop.blend_frames keys (the closing key included) are not plain copies of source frames; passes.ground is in the grounding avatar's metres
